newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia product tender summary - Petron to buy gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Asia product tender summary - Petron to buy gasoline.

text.p: PHILIPPINES' PETRON B 70,000/BBL 95-RON UNL GASOLINE, AUG 11-15 DELIVERY BATAAN, CLSG JULY 18.
